newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Placer names three to Highlands board.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Placer names three to Highlands board.

text.p: Highlands Gold Ltd said on Tuesday three Placer Dome Inc group representatives have been named to its five-member board, following Placer's gaining control of Highlands through its takeover bid.
Dick Zandee was named chairman, Russell Barwick, managing director and Mel Togolo a director.
Zandee is managing director of Placer Pacific Ltd,, which recently agreed to a merger with Placer Dome.
Barwick and Togolo hold executive positions with the Placer Niguini division of the company.
Three Highlands directors resigned on Friday.
Former Highlands' directors have recommended shareholders accept the A$0.75 a share takeover offer by Placer Dome that closes on February 8.

Placer Dome last week agreed to a restructuring plan forwarded by Highlands which involved a spin-off of a new company, Highlands Pacific Ltd, that would hold Highlands assets, excluding its 25 percent stake in the Porgera gold mine in Papua New Guinea which would become part of Placer Dome.
Through Placer Pacific, Placer Dome already holds a 25 percent interest in Porgera, which produced 250,508 ounces of gold in the last quarter.

Following the restructuring, Highland Pacific's main assets would include the Ramu nickel and cobalt and Frieda-Nena copper and gold finds, also in Papua New Guinea, as well as an exploration portfolio in Papua New Guinea and Indonesia.
The other owners of the Porgera mine are Goldfields Ltd, 25 percent, Orogen Minerals Ltd, 15 percent, and the Papua New Guinea government, 10 percent
